code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0})

    def cycle_from(start):
        i = colors.index(start)
        return colors[i:] + colors[:i]

    first_row = cycle_from(grid[0][0])
    later_rows = cycle_from(grid[0][1])
    out = []
    for r in range(h):
        if r == 0:
            out.append([first_row[c % len(first_row)] for c in range(w)])
        else:
            out.append([later_rows[(c if c < r else c - 1) % len(later_rows)] for c in range(w)])
    return out
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(code)
